title: Revert my textures!
description: Texture reversions to previous Jappa textures.
body:
Reverts some Jappa textures to previous iterations! :)
This reverts spawn eggs, redstone torches, and dyes to previous iterations of their textures/models!

This pack combines all my texture reversions into one pack!
List of seperate texture packs included
- [Reverted Eggs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/revertedeggs)
- [Reverted Redstone](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/revertedredstone)
- [Reverted Dye](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reverteddye)
